name: Catenoleimus
isnote: PBDB places it in Alexornithiformes; known from a single fragment, it is not placed by any analysis.
sum: Turonian bird from the Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan known from one fragment.
holotype: A single fragmentary bone from the Bissekty Formation (number in Panteleyev 1998).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Panteleyev 1998
